behaviors.inline-rename-control: A saved history entry has a Rename button that opens an inline name field.
behaviors.save-renamed-entry: Pressing Enter saves a new name for the selected entry and trims surrounding spaces.
behaviors.cancel-rename: Pressing Escape closes the name field and keeps the original name.
behaviors.reject-blank-name: Submitting a name containing only spaces keeps the original name.
behaviors.rename-timeline-snapshot: A Timeline snapshot can also be renamed.
behaviors.truncate-long-names: Long history names are truncated in the list, with the full name available on hover.

history.error: Check failed: Label is shortened and hover exposes its full title (locator.evaluate: ReferenceError: longName is not defined)
history.notes: The History button and row controls use their accessible names; the name span uses its title attribute to verify the full hover text. Advancing the page clock creates a Timeline snapshot without a minute of idle video.
History entry locators stay scoped to the first row in each tab. The truncation check passes the expected name into Playwright’s browser context, fixing the reported ReferenceError.
